question_or_symptom: The planned absorbed Git administration path was derived from the submodule worktree path and did not match standard Git behavior.
observation: A real temporary repository with submodule name example and path projects/example was migrated by git submodule absorbgitdirs to the root common directory modules/example, not modules/projects/example. The production .gitmodules uses lane IDs such as gem5 and llvm-project as submodule names.
conclusion: An absorbed submodule's administrative directory is keyed by its .gitmodules submodule name; the worktree path is a separate identity.
decision: Require canonical source IDs, compute the exact administration path as modules/<source-id>, require a relative .git gitfile pointing to that directory, and reject embedded repositories, absolute gitfiles, aliases, and linked worktrees at checkpoint acceptance.
invalidated_assumptions: git submodule absorbgitdirs mirrors every component of the submodule worktree path under .git/modules.
